# 1 - Setup

```{r, setup, include=FALSE}

pacman::p_load(
  writexl,
  sf,
  data.table,
  tidycensus,
  mapcdatakeys,
  tidyverse,
  imputeTS,
  collapse,
  stringi
)

# File paths
# Paths
if (grepl('VM',Sys.info()[['nodename']])){
  base <- '//data-sync/Public/DataServices'
} else {
  base <- 'S:/Network Shares/K Drive/DataServices'
}

root <- paste0(base,'/Projects/Current_Projects/Projections/Projections_2023/Data/03_UrbanSim/UrbanSim_Outputs/')
r1 <- paste0(base,'/Projects/Current_Projects/Projections/Projections_2023/Data/03_UrbanSim/')
r2 <- paste0(base,'/Projects/Current_Projects/Projections/Projections_2023/')
shop.path <- paste0(base,'/Projects/Current_Projects/Housing/StatewideHousingPlan/04_Analysis/Data/Working/Regional_Control_Totals/')

# Helpers
sun <- function(x){
  sort(unique(x))}
lun <- function(x){
  length(unique(x))}
sna <- function(x){
  sort(names(x))}

mpos <- all_muni_data_keys |> 
  pull(mpo) |> 
  unique()

munis <- all_muni_data_keys |> 
  select(muni_id, rpa_acr, mpo) |> 
  setDT()

nonmapc <- munis[mpo!='MAPC']

blks <- geog_xw_2010 |> 
  left_join(munis, by = 'muni_id') |> 
  select(bl10_id, muni_id, muni_name, rpa_acr, mpo) |> 
  setDT()

mapc_blks <- blks |> 
  filter(mpo=='MAPC') |> 
  pull(bl10_id)

m2 <- all_muni_data_keys |> 
  select(muni_id, muni_name, muni_upper) |> 
  setDT()

mapc_taz <- taz_sf |>
  filter(!muni_id %in% nonmapc) |>
  pull(tazID)

# blk.sf <- block_sf(2010)

knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
```

# 3 - UrbanSim Block Indicator Compile

```{r}



for (yr in years) {
  exp.yr <- ifelse(yr < 2020, yr, yr + 1)
  
  for (run in c(MAPCM_run, SWM_run)) {
    if (run == MAPCM_run) {
      run.blk <- mapc_blks
    } else {
      run.blk <- blks |> filter(!bl10_id %in% mapc_blks) |> pull(bl10_id)
    }
    
    if (platform == 'offline') {
      dt <- fread(paste0(root, '/', run, '/block_indicators_', yr, '.csv'))
    } else {
      dt <- fread(
        paste0(
          root,
          '/',
          run,
          '/results_mapc_',
          run,
          '_block_indicators_',
          yr,
          '.csv'
        )
      )
    }
    dt <- dt |>
      filter(block_id %in% run.blk) |>
      setDT()
    
    dt[, year := exp.yr]
    
    dt <- dt[, .(
      year,
      block_id,
      muni_id,
      total_households,
      hh_owners,
      hh_renters,
      total_residential_units,
      single_fam,
      multi_fam,
      residential_unit_capacity,
      density_residential_units,
      unavailable_units,
      vacant_residential_units,
      ru_vacancy_rate,
      own_fam,
      rent_fam,
      own_single_fam,
      own_multi_fam,
      rent_single_fam,
      rent_multi_fam,
      sum_with_child,
      median_income,
      median_rent,
      median_value,
      income_35000l,
      income_35001_75000,
      income_75001_125000,
      income_125001_200000,
      income_200001p,
      workers_0,
      workers_1,
      workers_2,
      workers_3,
      workers_4p,
      total_jobs,
      density_jobs,
      jobs_aggr_sector_1,
      jobs_aggr_sector_2,
      jobs_aggr_sector_3,
      jobs_aggr_sector_4,
      jobs_aggr_sector_5,
      jobs_aggr_sector_6,
      jobs_aggr_sector_7,
      jobs_aggr_sector_8,
      jobs_aggr_sector_9,
      jobs_aggr_sector_10
    )]
    
    setnames(
      dt,
      collapse::.c(
        year,
        block_id_2010,
        muni_id,
        total_households,
        owner_households,
        renter_households,
        total_residential_units,
        single_fam_units,
        multi_fam_units,
        residential_unit_capacity,
        residential_units_per_acre,
        unavailable_units,
        vacant_residential_units,
        vacancy_rate,
        owner_units,
        renter_units,
        owner_single_fam_units,
        owner_multi_fam_units,
        renter_single_fam_units,
        renter_multi_fam_units,
        households_with_children,
        median_household_income,
        median_household_rent,
        median_home_value,
        households_income_under35000,
        households_income_35001_75000,
        households_income_75001_125000,
        households_income_125001_200000,
        households_income_over200001,
        households_with_workers_0,
        households_with_workers_1,
        households_with_workers_2,
        households_with_workers_3,
        households_with_workers_4plus,
        total_jobs,
        jobs_per_acre,
        jobs_aggr_sector_1,
        jobs_aggr_sector_2,
        jobs_aggr_sector_3,
        jobs_aggr_sector_4,
        jobs_aggr_sector_5,
        jobs_aggr_sector_6,
        jobs_aggr_sector_7,
        jobs_aggr_sector_8,
        jobs_aggr_sector_9,
        jobs_aggr_sector_10
      )
    )
    dt[, residential_unit_capacity := round(residential_unit_capacity)]
    dt[, residential_units_per_acre := round(residential_units_per_acre, 3)]
    dt[, jobs_per_acre := round(jobs_per_acre, 3)]
    dt[, median_household_income := round(median_household_income)]
    dt[, median_household_rent := round(median_household_rent)]
    dt[, median_home_value := round(median_home_value)]
    dt[, vacancy_rate := round(vacancy_rate, 2)]
    setorder(dt, block_id_2010)
    
    fwrite(
      dt,
      paste0(
        root,
        '/',
        run,
        '/',
        run,
        '_block_indicators_summary',
        exp.yr,
        '.csv'
      )
    )
  }
  swm <- fread(paste0(
        root,
        '/',
        SWM_run,
        '/',
        SWM_run,
        '_block_indicators_summary',
        exp.yr,
        '.csv'
      ))
  mpc <- fread(paste0(
        root,
        '/',
        MAPCM_run,
        '/',
        MAPCM_run,
        '_block_indicators_summary',
        exp.yr,
        '.csv'
      ))
  comp <- rbind(swm,mpc)
  setorder(comp,block_id)
  fwrite(comp, paste0(root,'/',ctps_run,'_block_indicators_summary_',exp.yr,'.csv'))
  message(paste0(yr,' Complete'))
}
```


# 4 - UrbanSim TAZ Indicator Compile

```{r}

for (yr in years) {
  exp.yr <- ifelse(yr < 2020, yr, yr + 1)
  
  for (run in c(MAPCM_run, SWM_run)) {
    if (run == MAPCM_run) {
      run.taz <- mapc_taz
    } else {
      run.taz <- taz |> 
        rename(taz_id=tazID) |> 
        filter(!taz_id %in% mapc_taz) |> 
        pull(taz_id)
    }

      muni_id,
```
